title: Cannot disable `mbedtls` when building export templates with `MSVC`
body:
### Tested versions

4.8 master

### System information

github actions windows-latest

### Issue description

custom.build:
```
"disabled_build_options": {
		"disable_3d": true,
		"disable_navigation_2d": true,
		"disable_navigation_3d": true,
		"disable_physics_2d": true,
		"disable_physics_3d": true,
		"disable_xr": true,
		"module_godot_physics_2d_enabled": false,
		"module_godot_physics_3d_enabled": false,
		"module_jolt_physics_enabled": false,
		"module_openxr_enabled": false
	},
```

```
            d3d12=yes
            profile=../mvl-repo/MVL/GodotBuildProfile/custom.py
            build_profile=../mvl-repo/MVL/GodotBuildProfile/custom.build
            angle=${{ steps.angle-sdk.outputs.ANGLE_ENABLED }}
```

error:
```
Compiling thirdparty\mbedtls\godot\godot_mbedtls_platform.cpp ...
Compiling thirdparty\mbedtls\tf-psa-crypto\core\psa_crypto.c ...
Compiling thirdparty\mbedtls\tf-psa-crypto\core\psa_crypto_client.c ...

```

The editor build and the Godot repository's own build have no issues, and I can also build the Release Template normally on my local Linux system.
